chunks: Al-Mufaddal said: I heard al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say to his companions:
Whoever finds the coolness of our love upon his heart, let him increase his supplications for his mother, for indeed she did not betray his father.

key_terms.بَرْد: Coolness — metaphor for tranquility, comfort, and certainty in the heart
key_terms.تَخُن: To betray — here refers to marital infidelity, i.e., the mother's chastity
key_terms.حُبّ: Love — devotion to the Ahlulbayt, considered a sign of faith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about love of the Ahlulbayt and honoring one's mother?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS), speaking to his close companions including al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, connects love of the Ahlulbayt with the moral purity of one's lineage. The "coolness" (bard) of love is an Arabic metaphor for tranquility and certainty in the heart. The Imam teaches that those who experience genuine devotion to the Ahlulbayt should be grateful to their mothers, whose chastity and faithfulness ensured the purity of lineage through which this love was transmitted.
